name: Metallurgical Corporation of China Ltd.
summary: Metallurgical Corporation of China Ltd. (MCC), encompassing its various subsidiary companies, conducts a broad array of operations, including engineering contracting, property development, equipment manufacturing, and resource extraction, across both domestic Chinese and international markets. Its Engineering Contracting division is dedicated to furnishing comprehensive engineering, construction, and associated contractual services for both metallurgical and non-metallurgical undertakings. The Property Development segment concentrates on creating and marketing residential, commercial, and general housing properties, alongside preparing land for development. Within its Equipment Manufacturing segment, MCC undertakes the design and fabrication of specialized metallurgical machinery, steel frameworks, and a variety of other metallic goods. Finally, the Resource Development arm oversees the exploration, extraction, and processing of mineral deposits, in addition to producing non-ferrous metals and polysilicon. Established in 2008, the corporation maintains its headquarters in Beijing, located within the People's Republic of China.
